# Draft:Timeline of the Kazakh–Dzungar Wars

This is the Timeline of the Kazakh–Dzungar Wars which were a series of military conflicts between the Kazakh Khanate and the Dzungar Khanate, with each of those nations supported by various nations and empires, lasting from the 17th century to the mid-18th century.
Background
In 1467, the Oirats invaded Uzbek Khanate, capturing major cities on the Syr Darya region, including the city of Sighnaq. Meanwhile the Kazakh nobles of Janibek and Kerei khan seized the opportunity and seceded from the Uzbek Khanate and created the Kazakh Khanate in 1465, the valleys of Chu and Talas rivers.
The conflict between the Kazakhs and the Oirats started as early in the 1530's, with the Oirats being subjugated by the Batmongke Khan of the Northern Yuan and repelled by the Altan khan of the Tumeds, The Oirats attacked the Kazakhs frequently whilst as the Kazakhs attempted to subjugate them
